original_ai_output.title_zh: 利比亚西部暴雨引发洪灾，总理下令救援
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 利比亚西部多个城镇周五夜间遭遇暴雨引发的严重洪灾，电力和自来水供应中断，居民被泥流围困。总理阿卜杜勒哈米德·德贝巴已下令有关部门立即调动资源，确保快速响应。社交媒体流传的视频和图片显示有人被困车中或试图逃离泥流。

key_facts.fact: 利比亚西部多个城镇遭遇暴雨引发的严重洪灾
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Torrential rains caused severe flooding across several towns in western Libya overnight Friday

key_facts.fact: 洪灾导致电力和自来水供应中断，居民被泥流围困
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: cutting electricity and running water and trapping residents in torrents of mud

key_facts.fact: 总理德贝巴下令立即调动资源以确保快速响应
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah ordered authorities to immediately mobilise resources in affected areas "to ensure a rapid response"

key_facts.fact: 社交媒体流传的视频和图片显示有人被困车中或试图逃离泥流
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Videos and images circulated on social media showed people trapped in vehicles or trying to escape the mudflows

uncertainties: 伤亡与损失情况尚未确认
目前仅一个来源（Africanews）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
